handoffPurpose: Post-commit/post-push handoff to test the new handoff workflow in a fresh chat.
currentUserGoal: Open a new chat and verify that the workflow works: read AGENTS.md, read handoffs/LATEST.json, read this handoff, run git status --short, and continue from the current project state.

startSession: Read the handoff file referenced by latestHandoff.
Continue from the newest user goal and respect dirty worktree notes.
endSession: Create a dated handoff in handoffs/.
Update handoffs/LATEST.json to point to it.
Keep durable design docs in docs/ and short-lived session state in handoffs/.
